description: This module allows to manage posix users on a univention corporate server (UCS). It uses the Python API of the UCS to create a new object or edit it.

parameters.name: birthday
parameters.description: Birthday.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City of users business address.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country of users business address.

parameters.name: department_number
parameters.description: Department number of users business address.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description (not gecos).

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Display name (not gecos).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: A list of e-mail addresses. Default: [""]

parameters.name: employee_number
parameters.description: Employee number.

parameters.name: employee_type
parameters.description: Employee type.

parameters.name: firstname
parameters.description: First name. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: gecos
parameters.description: GECOS.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: POSIX groups, the LDAP DNs of the groups is found with the LDAP filter for each group as $GROUP: (&(objectClass=posixGroup)(cn=$GROUP)). Default: []

parameters.name: home_share
parameters.description: Home NFS share. Must be a LDAP DN, for example cn=home,cn=shares,ou=school,dc=example,dc=com.

parameters.name: home_share_path
parameters.description: Path to home NFS share, inside the homeShare.

parameters.name: home_telephone_number
parameters.description: List of private telephone numbers. Default: []

parameters.name: homedrive
parameters.description: Windows home drive, for example "H:".

parameters.name: lastname
parameters.description: Last name. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: mail_alternative_address
parameters.description: List of alternative e-mail addresses. Default: []

parameters.name: mail_home_server
parameters.description: FQDN of mail server.

parameters.name: mail_primary_address
parameters.description: Primary e-mail address.

parameters.name: mobile_telephone_number
parameters.description: Mobile phone number. Default: []

parameters.name: organisation
parameters.description: Organisation.

parameters.name: ou
parameters.description: Organizational Unit inside the LDAP Base DN, for example school for LDAP OU ou=school,dc=example,dc=com. Default: ""

parameters.name: overridePWHistory
parameters.description: Override password history. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: overridePWLength
parameters.description: Override password check. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: pager_telephonenumber
parameters.description: List of pager telephone numbers. Default: []

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: List of telephone numbers. Default: []

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Define the whole position of users object inside the LDAP tree, for example cn=employee,cn=users,ou=school,dc=example,dc=com. Default: ""

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Postal code of users business address.

parameters.name: primary_group
parameters.description: Primary group. This must be the group LDAP DN. If not specified, it defaults to cn=Domain Users,cn=groups,$LDAP_BASE_DN.

parameters.name: profilepath
parameters.description: Windows profile directory.

parameters.name: pwd_change_next_login
parameters.description: Change password on next login. Choices: "0" "1"

parameters.name: room_number
parameters.description: Room number of users business address.

parameters.name: samba_privileges
parameters.description: Samba privilege, like allow printer administration, do domain join. Default: []

parameters.name: samba_user_workstations
parameters.description: Allow the authentication only on this Microsoft Windows host. Default: []

parameters.name: sambahome
parameters.description: Windows home path, for example '\\$FQDN\$USERNAME'.

parameters.name: scriptpath
parameters.description: Windows logon script.

parameters.name: secretary
parameters.description: A list of superiors as LDAP DNs. Default: []

parameters.name: serviceprovider
parameters.description: Enable user for the following service providers. Default: [""]

parameters.name: shell
parameters.description: Login shell. Default: "/bin/bash"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the user is present or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: street
parameters.description: Street of users business address.

parameters.name: subpath
parameters.description: LDAP subpath inside the organizational unit, for example cn=teachers,cn=users for LDAP container cn=teachers,cn=users,dc=example,dc=com. Default: "cn=users"

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title, for example Prof..

parameters.name: unixhome
parameters.description: Unix home directory. If not specified, it defaults to /home/$USERNAME.

parameters.name: update_password
parameters.description: always updates passwords if they differ. on_create only sets the password for newly created users. Choices: "always" ← (default) "on_create"

parameters.name: userexpiry
parameters.description: Account expiry date, for example 1999-12-31. If not specified, it defaults to the current day plus one year.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: User name.

examples:
- name: Create a user on a UCS
  community.general.udm_user:
    name: FooBar
    password: secure_password
    firstname: Foo
    lastname: Bar

- name: Create a user with the DN uid=foo,cn=teachers,cn=users,ou=school,dc=school,dc=example,dc=com
  community.general.udm_user:
    name: foo
    password: secure_password
    firstname: Foo
    lastname: Bar
    ou: school
    subpath: 'cn=teachers,cn=users'

# or define the position
- name: Create a user with the DN uid=foo,cn=teachers,cn=users,ou=school,dc=school,dc=example,dc=com
  community.general.udm_user:
    name: foo
    password: secure_password
    firstname: Foo
    lastname: Bar
    position: 'cn=teachers,cn=users,ou=school,dc=school,dc=example,dc=com'
